name: MOOGM Gwangalli - Female-only Dormitory
detail: I booked this place while searching for accommodation in Busan. I arrived earlier than the check-in time, but they kindly took care of my luggage, allowing me to start my trip comfortably. The accommodation is very close to Gwangalli Beach, making the location really good, and it's easy to find for first-time visitors. I didn't have high expectations due to the low price when making the reservation, but it turned out to be better than expected. The hotel was very clean, the room was in good condition, and there was a window, so it wasn't stuffy and was pleasant. Thanks to that, my trip to Busan became even more enjoyable and left me with special memories. If I come to Busan again, I would love to stay at this accommodation again. 😊

name: Centum Business Hotel
detail: If you're looking for a budget-friendly hotel in Busan, this is the place!! Highly recommended!! 📍Location The location was great, about a 5-minute walk from Centum City Station. There are nearby attractions like BEXCO, Shinsegae Department Store, Lotte Department Store, Olive Young, and convenience stores, making it very convenient for my Busan trip. 🫡Facilities On the first floor of the hotel, there are GS25 and Emart24, and there is also a gym within the hotel. Especially, there are multiple elevators, making it easy to move quickly even from higher floors. This is definitely a major advantage!! 🛌Rooms The room was a bit smaller than I expected, but overall it was very clean. I was particularly satisfied with the bedding, which was dry and clean. I left the bedding change card during my two-night stay, and they replaced it with new bedding, and they also replenished the towels and bottled water. The bathroom was clean and surprisingly spacious, with a comfortable shower area. The staff were also very kind and helpful. Above all, I was satisfied as I could stay clean and comfortably without worrying about bedding, ventilation, or cigarette smells. If I'm looking for accommodation near Centum City or BEXCO again, I would definitely choose this place again~~~!!!

name: Urbanstay Seomyeon
detail: I stayed for three nights alone. Good points → It’s right by exit 12 of Seomyeon Station, there’s a convenience store on the first floor with a wowpass machine, and the self-checkout is easy to use. You can leave your luggage after checkout, there’s a kitchen and plates in the room, a desk and chair make it easy to live, there’s a washbasin, a full-length mirror, ample space for a suitcase, and plenty of towels provided. There’s also a washing machine for laundry. Online check-in means no face-to-face interaction with hotel staff, and if anything comes up, they reply quickly when contacted. Bad points → The toilet does not flush toilet paper, and the toilet and shower space are together without a shower curtain, so the toilet does get wet, though not as much as I expected. It was disappointing that the air conditioner was moldy; I hardly used it because of that. There was a moldy smell, and when I turned on the air conditioner, I could see the mold visibly. Overall, it was a good hotel, so I would like to stay again if I’m alone!

name: Lala Vianco Business Hotel
detail: A couple's retirement trip. On our return from Vietnam, instead of just a transit, we decided to spend a night in Busan. The hotel was recommended by a YouTuber who often shares about Busan travel. It's not a large hotel, but it's about the size of a Japanese business hotel, and the room was wonderful, clean, and had thoughtful touches throughout. It's a 5-minute walk from Seomyeon Station and close to Lotte Department Store, markets, and restaurant streets; the location is excellent. There were also many bars nearby, but at a supermarket just a 2-minute walk away, we could buy souvenirs like snacks and Korean seaweed at a pretty good price. Above all, during check-in, the receptionist (who I believe was a Japanese woman) provided polite and friendly explanations in Japanese. They offered a complimentary breakfast of just bread and coffee, and there was even a washing machine in the basement. This hotel is highly recommended for those who want a budget-friendly experience, feeling local life rather than staying in a luxury five-star hotel.

name: Nomad Live Hostel
detail: I have never known a hostel that boasts such refined adulthood beyond here. If you're planning to tour and engage in activities around Haeundae, this is a better choice. Since many users are from Europe and America, English is the primary language, but there seem to be quite a few Japanese guests as well. The staff are friendly, kind, and always present. The cleanliness is also commendable. There is an atmosphere reminiscent of an office, and while there are rooms where you can play, you can also spend time quietly alone or socialize until late at night. The rooms are capsule-style but equipped with individual electronic keys for high security. The shower rooms, toilets, and sinks are clean and well-maintained. Coffee is always available for free. Breakfast consists of light snacks (toast with jam). There are many dining options in the surrounding area. The downsides are that the beds are too soft and it's a bit far from downtown Busan. I really recommend it if you're using areas like Gwangalli or Haeundae. I think women can also feel safe here.

name: Gwanganli Hotel 1
detail: I am Japanese, and I went to Busan alone, but I really made the right choice by staying at this hotel. The staff were very friendly, the facilities were clean, the beach in front was breathtakingly beautiful, and the Greek yogurt for breakfast was very delicious. I don’t think there was anything wrong at all. If I had to say something, it would be that the hairdryer cannot be used after 10 PM, but there are so many good points that I don’t really mind at all. I definitely want to stay here again! Thank you very much.

name: Toyoko Inn Busan Station 1
detail: I used this hotel for my first solo trip to Busan. This time, I went sightseeing in Seoul by train from Busan, and since my return train was expected to arrive after midnight, its proximity to the station—so close that I could call it directly connected—and the bright surroundings were truly reassuring. There are various shops inside Busan Station. There are also many convenience stores and restaurants around the hotel, with a Dunkin' Donuts right next door, making it very convenient. The ability to store my luggage in the lobby lockers before check-in and after check-out was also helpful. Additionally, since there’s a taxi stand right in front of the hotel, moving back to the airport was smooth, and everything remained stress-free until the end. The room had a large bed that was super comfortable. The air conditioning worked well, and the lighting was bright and comfortable. The spacious refrigerator was also convenient. The amenities included one bottle of water, one large and one small towel, non-disposable slippers, body soap, and shampoo & conditioner. There wasn't a closet, but there were hangers, so I was able to hang my clothes. The staff spoke Japanese, which helped me feel secure during my first solo trip. At the breakfast buffet, the porridge and oden were particularly delicious, and there was a variety of bread and drinks. Even for someone like me who isn't fond of spicy food, there were plenty of non-spicy options, so I was able to enjoy a proper meal every morning. I am completely satisfied with the location, sense of安心, comfort, and service. I definitely want to stay here again when I visit Busan!

name: Goodday CUBE Seomyeon Capsule Hotel
detail: I hurriedly found this place and checked in alone, and I was really pleasantly surprised! The hotel itself seemed newly built, and everything was extremely clean and well-maintained. The bedding was dry and the pillows were Sealy. The shower room and shared spaces were also clean, and honestly, I didn't have high expectations for the room since it was small, but I slept so well that it felt cozier than expected. (It felt like coming out of hibernation in a cave…) The location was good, making public transportation convenient, and the staff was friendly. I think this is a great place for solo travelers to stay comfortably and lightly. The value for money was also satisfying, so I would be willing to use it again next time. I enjoyed the bread you baked for breakfast.

name: Sota suite busan seomyeon
detail: The location was great for walking access, and the spacious rooms allowed for a comfortable stay. The environment was conducive to a good night's sleep, and the breakfast was satisfying. Thanks to the friendly attitude of the staff, the cleanliness of the accommodations, and the various amenities, it was overall a cost-effective experience.

name: Toyoko Inn Busan Seomyeon
detail: I've stayed at the Toyoko Inn in Somyon for the first time, and I was surprised by the various services, including the free ones. There is a Wowpass machine in the lobby. Free pajamas, an ice maker, a water server, and a coin laundry were extremely helpful. The room has a toilet with a washlet and a bathtub. In the morning, there is a free breakfast. Although the selection is small, the menu changes slightly every day, and since it's a buffet, you can eat as much as you want. You can also drink free coffee until 10:30 in the morning. It's within walking distance not only from Seomyeon Station but also from Bujeon Station. It was convenient.
